correctness.rationale: For compact invariant probability support in strict positive octant, log Z is a bounded smooth observable and invariance yields 0=gamma2 E[m2P/(alpha2+P)]-D2. Rewriting P/(a+P)=1-a/(a+P) gives E[(a+P)^(-1)]=(a+p*)^(-1), p*=D2 a/(gamma2 m2-D2), if gamma2*m2>D2. Expanding 1/(a+P) exactly around the mean m=E[P] yields m-p*=(a+p*)/(a+m) E[(P-m)^2/(a+P)]; nonnegative, zero iff P constant. Stationarity with P=p*, Z positive constant and strictly monotone f1 forces N constant and hence the unique coexistence equilibrium. Continuous nonconstant cycles must take prey values strictly below and above p* to have the stated reciprocal average. Check numerical p*=1/4 (D2=1) and p*=13/34 (D2=13/10) with a=1/2, gamma2*m2=3. No assertion of existence of a cycle or boundary measures.
